note: Starting values for the ANDELI CUT-65DS (FPT60 torch) sold with the Porta Plasma table, at 230 V. There is no official Andeli speed table: speeds follow the PrimeWeld CUT60 table for the same thicknesses (a close 60-65 A air plasma), with more amps on thick plate. Stainless is about 80 % and aluminium about 115 % of the mild steel speed. Porta Plasma test pending: Josh replaces these with tested values. Always test on scrap.

profile.name: ANDELI CUT-65DS
profile.cnc_ports: 2-pin arc voltage + 4-pin signal (divider ratio to be measured)
profile.source: Andeli listing and factory spec table (pierce 5/16 in at 220 V, 1/4 in at 110 V; duty 30 % at 65 A, 60 % at 55 A, 100 % at 45 A)

supply_source: 16 A = full power (Josh). 13 A and 110 V caps are placeholders until Josh tests them.

sources.title: PrimeWeld CUT60 Cutting Speed Reference Table (official user manual)
sources.what: Amps, air PSI, cut speed (IPM) and distance-to-work 0.06 in for mild steel, stainless and aluminium from 26 ga to 3/4 in. Converted here to mm and mm/min (× 25.4).
sources.also: The same table as a one-page PDF: https://forum.langmuirsystems.com/uploads/short-url/yLt8kbbpOWWVVRPmM4CL2HKpoxX.pdf

sources.title: P80 cutting parameters (Heavth)
sources.what: P-80 nozzle/current bands and 'piercing height (generally not less than 5 mm)'. 60 A is listed for 5–15 mm plate at 800–1600 mm/min (a range, not a per-thickness table). Air 5 bar.

sources.title: CUT-60 kerf, Langmuir Systems forum (May 2021)
sources.what: User-reported kerf of about 0.050 in (1.27 mm) on a CUT-60 with a 0.9 mm / 40 A tip, 1/4 in and thinner. Not an official chart.

small_holes.source: Hypertherm hole-cutting guidance for air plasma: holes smaller than about 25 mm (1 in) come out rounder, with less taper, when cut at about 60 % of the chart speed. A starting point: test on scrap.

materials.name: Galvanised
materials.tip: Galvanised: cuts like mild steel, but the zinc coating gives off harmful fumes. Extraction on and wear a mask rated for metal fume.

materials.name: Zintec
materials.tip: Zintec: thin zinc-coated mild steel. Cut it like mild steel, with extraction on.

materials.name: Corten
materials.tip: Corten (weathering steel): cut it like mild steel.

materials.name: Chequer plate
materials.tip: Chequer plate: measure the plate under the tread pattern, not over it, and cut tread side up.
